title: The Impact of Differential Privacy on Group Disparity Mitigation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the absolute difference in predictive performance (Accuracy, F1 score, MSE) between gender subgroups (e.g., men vs. women) across face attribute detection, text topic classification, speech-based stock volatility forecasting, and text sentiment analysis under varying levels of differential privacy.

Measuring the absolute difference in predictive performance (F1 score) between different age subgroups (e.g., young vs. old) for text-based topic classification and sentiment analysis tasks under varying levels of differential privacy.
